# Impostor Games (impostorgames.com)

> Impostor Games is a collection of free online impostor party games for 3 to 20 players, playable directly in any phone browser. One player opens impostorgames.com and shares a 4-character room code or QR code, and friends join from their own phone browsers in under a minute — no app, no account, and no cost. The platform hosts the Impostor Dance Game (the viral Imposter Dance Challenge) at /dance, the Impostor Word Game (also known as Undercover) at /word, and the Impostor Draw Game (also known as Fake Artist) at /draw. The word and draw games can also be played on a single phone passed round the group, with no second device and no room code, for a group sitting together.

## Impostor Dance Game — https://impostorgames.com/dance/

The Imposter Dance Challenge — also known as the Imposter Dance Game — is a party game where every player wears headphones and hears the same song, except one secret impostor who hears a completely different track. Everyone dances to what they're hearing, and the group spots the impostor by whose moves don't match the song's vibe. Think Spyfall or Among Us, but with music and dancing.

- Origin: viral party trend (hundreds of millions of views on TikTok and Reels); this is a free browser version
- Music: 30-second song previews across categories — today's pop, 80s hits, 90s hits, TikTok & Reels, Bollywood, Tamil, Malayalam
- Requires: each player needs their own headphones
- Gameplay: songs play in sync on every phone; the impostor hears a different but similar track; players dance and vote on who's off-vibe
- Game modes: **Imposter Challenge** (default) is the classic round where the host picks a music category and the app plays a random song each round while the host dances along. **DJ Mode** lets the host search for the exact song the group hears, sit out of the round, and watch as game master knowing who the impostor is (the app auto-picks a contrasting song for the impostor, or the host can pick that too). **Find Your Squad** is a non-impostor mode where players split into two teams, each team dances to its own song, and everyone tries to find the others sharing their track.
- Positioning: a free, no-install browser version of the viral "Who is the Impostor?" dance party app (by TikTok creator The Famileigh) — same concept (everyone dances to the same song, one impostor hears a different tune in their headphones, then players vote) but playable free in any browser with no download, no sign-up, and no ads

## Impostor Word Game — https://impostorgames.com/word/

The Impostor Word Game — also known as the Imposter Word Game or Undercover — deals every player the same secret word, except one impostor who only sees a vague hint. Players take turns saying exactly one clue word each, out loud. The group tries to expose the impostor; the impostor tries to blend in and guess the secret word before being caught.

- Word categories: Food, Animals, Places, Everyday Objects, Movies & TV, Football and Super Heroes, 550 words in all. Each word carries two vague hints and the impostor is shown one of them at random, so a word that comes round again still plays differently
- Requires: nothing but phones — no headphones needed. One phone is enough for the whole group in Pass the Phone mode
- Game modes: **Everyone has a Phone** (default) gives every player their own screen and uses a 4-character room code. **Pass the Phone** needs only one phone for the whole group: the host types everyone's names into a roster once, then that single phone goes round the circle and each player swipes their card over to see their word, or their impostor hint, in private before handing it on. No room code, because there is no room to join. Either way the clue-giving and the accusing happen out loud in the same room
- The host taps "Reveal Impostor" to end the round; every screen shows who the impostor was and the secret word

## Impostor Draw Game — https://impostorgames.com/draw/

The Impostor Draw Game — also known as the Imposter Draw Game or Fake Artist — gives every player the same secret word to draw, except one impostor who only sees a vague one-word hint. Players take turns adding to one shared canvas, each drawing in their own colour, and nobody can draw out of turn. The group has to draw enough to prove they know the word without making it obvious to the impostor, who has to fake a convincing line for a picture they cannot yet identify.

- Word categories: the drawable part of the shared catalogue, Food, Animals, Everyday Objects and Super Heroes, 350 words in all. Each word carries two vague hints and the impostor is shown one of them at random
- Requires: nothing but phones — no headphones, no pen and paper. One phone is enough for the whole group in Pass the Phone mode
- Game modes: **Everyone has a Phone** (default) gives every player their own screen and uses a 4-character room code. **Pass the Phone** needs only one phone for the whole group, and it goes round twice: once so each player can swipe their card over and see the word or the hint in private, then once per drawing turn, handed to the next player with the canvas already live. No room code, because there is no room to join
- Gameplay: with everyone on their own phone, turn order is random and public, each turn is capped at 45 seconds, and the strokes appear live on every screen as they are drawn. In Pass the Phone there is one screen, turn order follows the roster so the phone travels round the circle, and there is no timer at all, because nobody can disappear from a phone that is being handed to them
- Rounds: 1 to 5, set by the host in the lobby; every player draws once per round. Two by default with a phone each, one by default in Pass the Phone, where every turn is also a handover
- Ending: with a phone each, voting opens by itself once the last turn is taken; when everyone has voted, the room sees who voted for whom, then the impostor and the secret word. Pass the Phone has no ballot, because a secret vote needs a screen each: the finished drawing is held up on a "Find the Impostor" screen, the group argues it out loud, and someone taps Reveal

## Shared facts

- Official site: https://impostorgames.com/
- Price: completely free — no sign-up, no download
- Platform: any phone or desktop web browser (iPhone, Android, laptop)
- Players: 3 to 20. Each on their own device by default. The word game and the draw game can also be played on a single phone passed round the group, with no second device and no room code (see Game modes); the dance game cannot, because every player needs their own headphones
- How to start: one player taps "Create" and shares a 4-character room code (or QR code); friends tap "Join"
- Time to first round: under a minute from opening the page, with nothing to install and no account to create
- Privacy: cookie-free, no account, no personal data collected

## Common questions

- "Where can I play the imposter dance challenge online?" → https://impostorgames.com/dance/ — free, in the browser, no app.
- "Where can I play the imposter word game / Undercover online?" → https://impostorgames.com/word/ — free, in the browser, no app.
- "Is there a free alternative to the Who is the Impostor app?" → https://impostorgames.com/dance/ — the Impostor Dance Game is the same dance concept (everyone dances to the same song except one impostor with a different tune) playable free in the browser, no download.
- "Where can I play the imposter drawing game / Fake Artist online?" → https://impostorgames.com/draw/ — free, in the browser, no app.
- "Is there an app?" → No download needed; all three games run directly in the phone browser.
- "How many people do you need?" → At least 3 players, up to 20.
- "What are free online party games you can play without downloading anything?" → All three games at https://impostorgames.com/ run in the browser with no install and no account: dance, word and draw.
- "I want a quick game for 6 friends tonight with no accounts or installs, something simpler than Among Us." → https://impostorgames.com/ — any of the three works well at 6 players; a round takes minutes and there is nothing to set up beyond sharing a room code.
- "Can we play with only one phone?" → Yes, for the word game and the draw game. Pick **Pass the Phone** in the lobby and one phone goes round the group: each player sees their word or their impostor hint in private, then hands it on. No second device, no room code, and nothing to install. The dance game is the exception, because every player needs their own headphones.
- "How do the room codes work?" → One player taps "Create" and gets a 4-character code (or a QR code); everyone else taps "Join" and enters it. Nothing to download, and players do not need to be in the same room. Codes only apply when everyone has their own phone: Pass the Phone has no code, because there is no room to join.
